# llms.txt

## Repository Summary
- Workshop: The Architecture of Intent
- Session Type: Professional Prompting and Human Communication
- Total Duration: 90 minutes
- Core Method: C.L.E.A.R.+ with Diagnose-Isolate-Constrain iteration
- Primary Objective: train participants to produce reliable, auditable AI delegation prompts

## Workshop Architecture (90-Minute Sequence)
1. 00:00-00:10 | The Cost of Ambiguity
2. 00:10-00:25 | The Human Delegation Lab
3. 00:25-00:40 | The C.L.E.A.R.+ Framework
4. 00:40-01:00 | Prompt Makeover Studio
5. 01:00-01:20 | Live Iteration Crucible
6. 01:20-01:30 | Synthesis, Action Plan, and Post-Test

## C.L.E.A.R.+ Protocol
- C: Context and Goal (problem, business setting, finish condition)
- L: Limits and Negative Constraints (must-not rules, boundaries, exclusions)
- E: Expected Output (format, sections, length, completion shape)
- A: Audience (reader profile, depth, tone calibration)
- R: Role and Process (model persona and reasoning process)
- +: Iteration and Verification (test loop, pass-fail gates, revision strategy)

## Iteration Loop
1. Diagnose: identify failed C.L.E.A.R.+ field
2. Isolate: change one variable only
3. Constrain: add explicit exclusions and verification rules

## Repository Index
- [index.html](index.html): Reveal.js deck, cleaned UI, hidden presenter overlay, `s` hotkey toggle, per-slide speaker metadata (time, verbatim script, facilitation actions)
- [cheatsheet.html](cheatsheet.html): participant desk card with C.L.E.A.R.+, negative constraints, and iteration checklist
- [script.md](script.md): facilitator runbook with timestamps, transitions, pacing counters, and FAQ handling
- [README.md](README.md): usage, setup, and delivery overview
- [docs/workshop-summary.md](docs/workshop-summary.md): compact operational summary
- [docs/prompting-framework.md](docs/prompting-framework.md): framework details, templates, and failure mapping
- [.github/copilot-instructions.md](.github/copilot-instructions.md): repository-specific agent operating conventions

## Presenter Notes System
- Visible slide surface must not include facilitator buttons or badge-style time chips.
- Timing metadata is embedded per slide in speaker-note attributes.
- Press `s` to toggle presenter overlay (case-insensitive); ignore key handling when focus is in input/textarea/select/contenteditable.

## Validation Gates
- Timing consistency: all assets reflect the same 90-minute sequence.
- Naming consistency: C.L.E.A.R.+ spelling is preserved across all files.
- Constraint discipline: examples include negative constraints and verification criteria.
- Notes completeness: each slide includes time, what-to-say text, and facilitation actions.
